note: Adapted from Roonwal & Rathore 1976; original in English; original description of a new species (Nasutitermes araujoi n. sp.), type locality Belterra, Pará, Brazil (type soldier in the Zoological Survey of India, Reg. No. 14/H11); alate unknown. Table 2 of the original gives the soldier measurements in two columns, type specimen and 10 paratypes, with the OCR column order scrambled; only values that can be matched confidently to a row are taken here. The various indices (nasus-head index, head constriction index etc.) and the full worker measurements (original Table 3) are not transcribed individually.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Related to the Peruvian N. maximus (Holmgren), differing as follows: soldier head including the nasus shorter (1.63—1.84 mm versus 1.90—2.05 mm) but wider (maximum width 1.26—1.37 mm versus 1.15—1.30 mm); antennae 13-segmented (versus 14), segment 3 shorter than segment 2 (versus longer than segment 2), segment 5 longer than segment 4 (versus shorter than segment 4); worker dimorphic (major and minor, versus monomorphic), head narrower (maximum width: major 1.32 mm, minor 1.05—1.11 mm; versus 1.58 mm), antennae 14-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark chestnut-brown, nasus paler; antennae pale yellow with brown edges; thoracic nota brownish, legs paler; abdomen pale brown. Head very sparsely hairy, with 2—3 longer hairs; nasus tip with several short hairs; abdomen moderately hairy, with several short and long hairs. Body length to the tip of the nasus 3.7—5.1 mm. Head capsule smooth, round, posterior margin nearly straight, slightly wider than long; nasus short, stout, nearly conical, about 1/3 the length of the rest of the head capsule; mandible tips visible from above. Head in lateral view slightly concave dorsally in the middle, with a weak elevation behind. Antennae 13-segmented, all rather hairy; segment 1 longest; segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 shortest; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2; from segment 5 onwards gradually longer. Labrum translucent, colourless, band-shaped, more than twice as wide as long, covered with small hairs. Postclypeus wider than the anteclypeus, with several hairs. Mandibles reduced, each with a distinct lateral toothless process. Postmentum nearly square, lateral margins angular, posterior margin with a long lateral process at each end, anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin distinctly convex. Pronotum saddle-shaped, moderately hairy, anterior lobe rounded; anterior margin convex, posterior margin nearly straight, neither with a median notch. Mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum, posterior margin without a median notch; metanotum wider than the mesonotum, posterior margin slightly concave, with 2 long bristles. Legs long and slender, moderately hairy; tibiae long, spinose; tibial spur formula 2:2:2; tarsi 4-segmented, the last segment with a pair of apical claws, without an empodium. Abdomen long, moderately hairy; cerci short and hairy (about 0.14 mm long) but distinct, the last segment pointed. No styli. Measurements from Table 2 of the original: head length including nasus 1.63—1.84 mm; head length without nasus 1.11—1.21 mm; nasus length 0.53—0.63 mm; maximum nasus width 0.37—0.47 mm; maximum head width 1.26—1.37 mm; minimum head width 0.63—0.74 mm; maximum head height 0.84—1.00 mm; pronotum length 0.16—0.24 mm, width 0.49—0.59 mm; hind tibia length 1.00—1.26 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head dark brown, with a narrow pale stripe along both arms of the Y-shaped suture; thoracic and abdominal dorsa pale brown; antennae, legs and sternites pale. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length about 5.8—6.1 mm. Head capsule nearly square; frontal gland at the intersection of the Y-shaped suture, a small round elevation about 0.05 mm in diameter. No eyes or ocelli. Antennae 14-segmented, rather hairy; segment 1 longest, stout and cylindrical; segment 2 about half of segment 1; segment 3 about as long as segment 2; segment 4 shortest, becoming longer and pear-shaped posteriorly. Labrum dome-shaped, with rather long hairs, wider than long, slightly pointed in the middle of the anterior margin. Mandibles yellowish brown. Left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the first marginal tooth about as long as the apical tooth, the second marginal tooth small and widely separated from the first by a concave margin; right mandible similar, but the second marginal tooth closer to the first. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, wider than long, rather hairy, with many fine hairs, a pair of longer hairs on each side anteriorly; anterior and posterior margins convex, the anterior margin with a distinct median notch, the posterior margin slightly concave. Legs long and slender; hind femur not reaching the tip of the abdomen; hind tibia longer than the hind femur. Tarsi 4-segmented; tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Abdominal tergites and sternites rather hairy. Cerci short, 2-segmented. No styli. Measurements: body length 5.8—6.1 mm; head length to mandible base 1.16—1.26 mm; maximum head width 1.32 mm; maximum head height 0.81—0.86 mm; labrum length 0.09—0.10 mm, width 0.43—0.54 mm; pronotum length 0.32—0.36 mm, width 0.74—0.81 mm; antennae 14-segmented. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller, body length 4.4—5.1 mm; head capsule pale brown; frontal gland indistinct; pronotum weakly saddle-shaped. Measurements: head length to mandible base 0.83—0.86 mm; maximum head width 1.05—1.11 mm; maximum head height 0.68—0.77 mm; labrum length 0.09 mm, width 0.36—0.45 mm; pronotum length 0.18—0.20 mm, width 0.56—0.59 mm.
